structure: p_win = softmax(share_score/temp + gamma*ACC_z); ACC = projected full-Sept accrual (PA; IP*4.3)
war_input: banked YTD bWAR (B-R war_daily_bat/pitch.txt, mlb_ID keyed)

crosstype_rule.means: per-race; WAR_z and ACC_z centered on whole field mean; HR/RBI/OPS on race HITTERS mean (hitters only); W/K on race PITCHERS mean (pitchers only)
crosstype_rule.off_type: z=0 exactly (a pitcher has HR_z=RBI_z=OPS_z=0; a hitter has W_z=K_z=0)

npb_vet_delta_provenance: PRIOR not fit: posted NPB/KBO veterans are discounted by ROY voters ("not a true rookie" sentiment; H. Matsui 2003 lost with 33 HR to a lesser season). Kept mild (-1.5, ~4.5:1) because a transcendent season can still win (Ichiro 2001). ROY only. Refit if a posted-vet-led race resolves.
